entry.title: Your server from anywhere, with nothing set up on the router
entry.summary: WittyMediaServer 0.8.0-alpha brings peer-to-peer connections. The apps reach your server from anywhere, with no port forwarding, no rented server and no account, encrypted to your server's key and open only to devices you approved.

entry.title: Better disc playback in Firefox
entry.summary: DVD and Blu-ray pictures and menu buttons line up again in Firefox, including in the mini player.

entry.title: Modules of their own, with a signed store
entry.summary: Every module moves out of the server into a project of its own, with a store to find them in. Real installers, help inside the app, and what to know before you update.

entry.title: Windows installer upgrades work again
entry.summary: A fix for error 2613 when installing over an earlier version, and every Windows installer now tested that way before it's published.

entry.title: WittyMediaClient’s first release of its own
entry.summary: The apps for TVs, phones and computers now have their own project, starting with desktop installers for every system and an Android app for testing.

entry.title: WittyReader, for books on your own device
entry.summary: Read and annotate books, PDFs and comics with no server and nothing uploaded. Its first release has installers for Windows, macOS and Linux.

entry.title: Games, live TV and a full audit
entry.summary: Console games streamed from your server, channels made from your library, live TV, photos, remote access, and the fixes from a full code and design audit.

entry.title: Music, books, podcasts and one-click updates
entry.summary: Libraries for music, audiobooks, books, comics, podcasts and anime, profiles for children, and updates that install themselves.

entry.title: DVD menus that work, and TV shows
entry.summary: The first release on GitHub, with a DVD engine of its own, a library for TV shows, themes and downloads for ten kinds of computer.
